## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible behavior.

## Related issues

Link relevant issues or write "None".

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo test`
- [ ] `cargo test --all-features` (when relevant)
- [ ] Documentation updated for public behavior changes

## Notes for reviewers

List feature flags, protocol assumptions, limitations, and any follow-up work.

Do not include credentials, tokens, signed URLs, or private player data.
